text:
Implemented:
- Iterable `VersionInfo` with normalized component types.
- Tuple comparisons, including short tuples.
- Immutable bump and replacement methods.
- Module-level `replace`.
- CLI functions supporting `compare`, `bump`, and `check` via `python -m semver`.

Existing read-only attributes remain enforced. Updated usage documentation and added `STATUS.json`.

Validation: all 106 existing tests passed, along with doctests and targeted requirement checks. No packaging or test configuration changed.
